name: East Bay Regional Park District Youth and Student Jobs
city: Oakland, CA and parks across Alameda and Contra Costa counties
what_you_do: You can get seasonal paid student jobs such as recreation leader, lifeguard, gate attendant, student laborer and interpretive student aide. The jobs include pathways from high school to college.
who_can_apply: Gate Attendant (high school pathway): at least 16 and completed 10th grade. Visitor Center Aide: 15 1/2 or older, no experience needed. Other jobs have their own rules; check each posting.
pay_detail: Each job posting lists pay. Visitor Center Aide: $22.38 to $23.55 an hour. Gate Attendant (returning staff, 2027): $20.34 to $21.40 an hour.
deadline_text: Visitor Center Aide closes Dec 30, 2026 at 5 PM. As of Nov 2, 2026 the other seasonal posts are for returning 2027 staff only. Watch ebparks.org/jobs/youth and governmentjobs.com/careers/ebparks for new ones.
notes: The 16 minimum is from the Gate Attendant page; other roles (for example lifeguard) may differ. The park district says it hires hundreds of seasonal students each year.
